Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You lay out the evidence, name the plan and show your companions the one part that must go right.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Time
One minute.
Target / range / shape
Self and up to three allies who can hear and understand you.
Duration
The plan and its stated limits remain known; each Boon expires when used or at the end of the scene.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per scene.
Type
Signature

Spend one minute forming a plan from the evidence and observations available. State the plan. The DA confirms what is true, what remains uncertain, and one contradiction or risk. You and each chosen ally gain 2 Boons to your next roll that directly follows the plan.

Additional rulings

Tags: Skill / Support
